messages.content: I need to settle Saturday. Compare the direct coach with the later train, including enough time to retrieve my bag after breakfast and get to the departure point.

The direct coach leaves downtown Providence at 10:20 a.m. With breakfast ending at 10:00, collecting the stored bag and reaching the stop would leave almost no margin. The workable rail option leaves Providence Station at 10:55 a.m., reaches Boston South Station at 12:03 p.m., then uses the Silver Line to Logan. Allowing 15 minutes for the transfer and about 25 minutes to the terminal, you should arrive around 12:45 p.m.
And the flight is at 2:35 from Boston, correct?
Correct. The confirmed return departs Boston Logan at 2:35 p.m. An arrival near 12:45 gives you about one hour and fifty minutes at the airport.
What time should I leave the hotel for the station? I will have to collect the bag first.

Collect it at 10:10 and leave by 10:20. The hotel-to-station ride is normally about 10 minutes, so that provides roughly 20 minutes at the station before the 10:55 departure. The hotel has confirmed complimentary storage after checkout.
That is better than trying to make the coach. Are there restrictions on the rail ticket?

The selected coach fare is nonrefundable. The rail fare is $29 and can be changed before departure, with any fare difference due; cancellation returns an eVoucher rather than cash. The local Silver Line transfer is included from South Station to Logan.
Choose the train and give me the completed schedule for the trip.

Selected: the 10:55 a.m. Saturday train from Providence to Boston South Station, arriving 12:03 p.m., followed by the Silver Line to Logan for an estimated 12:45 p.m. terminal arrival. Your completed trip is Thursday arrival in Providence, two nights at the downtown meeting hotel from December 3-5, and Saturday checkout before the author breakfast. Breakfast ends at 10:00 a.m.; retrieve the stored bag at 10:10, leave for Providence Station by 10:20, and take the rail transfer to the confirmed 2:35 p.m. Boston departure. The direct coach is not selected because its 10:20 departure does not leave a reliable bag-retrieval margin.
